brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility chain items with no serious or minor errors, demonstrating comprehensive safety assessment, appropriate medication boundary guidance, and effective caregiver teach-back. One high-order point (HO4) is fully completed through tailored navigation of the patient's reluctance and non-adherence barriers. While HO1 was triggered by anticoagulant discussion and HO2 by lab verification, both were partially addressed without completing the full correction/verification loop needed for high-order credit. Grade 4 reflects Strong performance with one meaningful high-order completion.
